'''''Poa compressa''''', the  '''Canada bluegrass'''<ref>{{PLANTS|id=POCO|taxon=Poa compressa|accessdate=31 January 2016}}</ref> or '''flattened meadow-grass''',<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |access-date=2014-10-17 }}</ref> is a [[perennial]] flattened meadow [[Poaceae|grass]], similar to common meadow-grass, ''[[Poa pratensis]]''.  It is native to Europe but it can be found nearly worldwide as an [[introduced species]]. It grows in old wall tops, pavement cracks, dry stony [[grassland]], and many types of wild habitat.  It has a flattened stem, 23–30 cm tall, a close one sided [[panicle]] of grey green, with purple [[floret]]s.

The [[ligule]] is rounded.
